items.title: 15.1.1 Basic Elements of Nervous Coordination (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the basic elements of nervous coordination (PDF 26-27).

blocks.text: Homeostasis ke liye nervous system sab se aham nizam hai: yeh doosre nizamon ko qaboo karta aur khud bhi homeostasis qaim rakhta hai. Homeostasis ke bunyadi ajza is ke zariye yun kaam karte hain.

items: Receptors: aaza, tissues ya cells jaise aankhein, kaan aur jild jo muharrik (stimuli), yaani bairooni aur andaruni mahol ki tabdeeliyan, pakarte hain. Yeh transducers ka kaam karte aur sensory neurons mein nerve impulses paida karte hain, jo unhein central nervous system tak le jate hain.

Central nervous system: control centre, yaani dimagh aur spinal cord, jo associative neurons (inter-neurons) se bane hain. Yeh sensory neurons se impulses le kar process karte aur motor neurons ke zariye effectors ko impulses bhejte hain.
Effectors: muscles aur glands jo CNS ke impulses ka jawab dete hain, muscles sukar kar aur glands ifraz kar ke.

blocks.title: Receptors transducers hain
blocks.text: Transducer tawanai ki aik shakal ko doosri mein badalta hai. Maslan retina ke rod aur cone cells roshni ki tawanai ko nerve impulses (electrochemical tawanai) mein badalte hain.
Is tarah nervous coordination mein paigham ka raasta hai: receptor, sensory neuron, CNS (inter-neurons), motor neuron, effector. Is raaste mein neurons functional units hain.

blocks.prompt: Garam pateele se haath hatate waqt paigham ka raasta batayein.
blocks.explanation: Jild ke garmi aur dard ke receptors, sensory neuron, spinal cord ke inter-neurons, motor neuron, baazu ke effector muscles jo sukar kar haath hatate hain.

items: Receptor (transducer), sensory neuron, CNS, motor neuron, effector (muscle ya gland).
